title: Trip checklist
intro: A detailed planning pass for bookings, reservations, and final trip preparation.

Confirm airport transfer and Tokyo arrival travel
Book Tokyo → Kyoto shinkansen
Confirm Kyoto ↔ Nara train plan
Confirm Nara → Osaka evening train
Book Osaka → Nagoya shinkansen
Book Nagoya → Hiroshima shinkansen
Reserve Hiroshima → Matsuyama Linear Jet
Plan Matsuyama → Yawatahama → Beppu ferry connection
Book Beppu/Oita → Tokyo flight
Decide whether Fukuoka remains in the itinerary and book travel if retained
Book Tokyo stay for arrival and final night
Book Kyoto stay
Confirm whether Nara is a day trip or needs a stay
Book Osaka stay
Book Nagoya stay
Confirm Hiroshima stay for the one-day visit
Book Matsuyama stay
Book Beppu/Yufuin onsen stay
Decide whether Fukuoka needs a stay if retained
Confirm Pokemon Center plans and opening hours
Identify Kyoto temples, restaurants, and timed-entry reservations
Confirm Nara Park route, feeding guidance, and return timing
Book Ghibli Park tickets and confirm entry details
Decide whether Miyajima fits after the Peace Park visit
Confirm ferry and speed-boat schedules and reservations
Check onsen reservation, etiquette, and tattoo policies
Make any priority restaurant reservations
Check passports, entry requirements, and travel documents
Arrange travel insurance
Arrange phone data, eSIM, or pocket Wi-Fi
Plan payment methods, IC cards, and access to cash
Decide luggage strategy for frequent city changes
